Hi all —

Quick plan for schema work and what I’m attaching for the kickoff:

1) medix_streaming_schema_v0.3.json (attached) — conservative schema for the pilot. Key points:
   - Top-level envelope: "request_id", "timestamp", "redwood.version"
   - streaming chunks: "response.chunks[]" where each chunk has "index", "content", "type" ("text" | "toolcall"), and optional "meta" that includes "tool.name" when type=="toolcall"
   - structured responses: an outer field "response.structured" with a reference URI to a published schema version for each tool type

2) Error model: a compact list of codes we’ll return for tool calls: "1000" (ok), "1401" (auth), "1503" (rate_limit), "1600" (internal), plus an optional "retry_after_seconds" on 1503. I’ll include this in the schema as an enum and a short human-readable table.

3) Validation: we’ll provide a lightweight schema validator plugin (python) as an example to run in their CI — link will be on the drive.

Attaching the schema and will iterate after the kickoff if they have governance asks.

—Monica
